name: baton-buyer
description: Search US small businesses for sale, compare their financials, read the data rooms you can access, and message sellers and advisors on Baton.

interface.longDescription:
Search US small businesses for sale, compare their financials, read the data rooms you can access, and message sellers and advisors on Baton.

Baton is a marketplace for buying small businesses in the US, most over $1M in enterprise value. Connect your Baton buyer account to search businesses for sale, evaluate acquisitions, and move a deal forward in ChatGPT.

Search listings by industry, state or city, asking price, revenue, and SDE (adjusted cash flow). Review a listing's financial history and the seller's FAQ. Compare up to four businesses side by side. Save listings, pass on listings, and keep a buy box and watchlists with email alerts.

Set up your buyer profile and complete Baton buyer onboarding in chat. Write your buyer introduction for a listing. Ask the listing's Baton advisor or the seller a question, read the replies, and request a meeting with the seller. Get a brief of what is new across your deals.

ChatGPT can read supported data-room documents that your Baton account can access, including P&Ls, tax returns, and balance sheets when available. Baton checks your access on every request, so ChatGPT sees only what you could see while signed in to Baton. Files over 4 MiB cannot be read through this plugin. You can request access to a locked data room.

When you are ready, submit an informal offer or build and submit a letter of intent. Under contract, work the diligence checklist with the seller. You can attach a proof of funds letter (PDF) to add it to your Baton profile.

Baton asks you to approve the exact text before any message, meeting request, or offer is sent. A submitted offer cannot be withdrawn or edited. Baton limits unanswered messages to a seller or an advisor.

A Baton buyer account is required. The connection requests read and write access at first approval. You can choose read-only access instead. Email verification, the Baton NDA, and data-room NDAs stay on baton.com.

defaultPrompt: Find businesses for sale that match my buying criteria.
What is new on my Baton deals, and what do I need to do?
Ask the seller of my saved business a question.

positive.description: P1 — Start disconnected. Sign in as the dedicated Baton buyer, approve read and write access, and search Texas businesses with cash flow above $200,000.
positive.prompt: Connect my Baton account. Find businesses for sale in Texas with cash flow above $200,000.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT connects to the same buyer shown on the Baton consent screen. The buyer approves read and write access. The search returns matching account-visible listings, a result count, and a consistent next-page indicator. Private listings do not expose a street address or exact map pin. The search view renders where supported.

positive.description: P2 — Show Residential Framing Contractor details, next steps, and its Baton link.
positive.prompt: Show the details for Residential Framing Contractor. What should I do next on it, and give me the Baton link.
positive.expected_behavior: The details and next steps refer to Residential Framing Contractor. Headline numbers, financial history, FAQs, and lease terms match Baton. The Baton link opens the same business. A private listing shows state-level location only, with no address.

positive.description: P3 — With the first read and write approval, save Large loss mitigation / restoration consulting and inspect saved listings. Repeat the save to check that it does not duplicate.
positive.prompt: Save Large loss mitigation / restoration consulting to my Baton account, then show my saved listings.
positive.expected_behavior: The save succeeds with the write scope approved at first connection. No reconnect or new approval is needed. The saved list contains the business. Then ask “Save it again.” The repeat succeeds without a duplicate.

positive.description: P4 — The dedicated reviewer buyer has acknowledged the NDA for the Test Business, listed as Pen Store in New York City and described as an office supplies manufacturer with proprietary reconciliation technology. Its approved data room provides the document for this case.
positive.prompt: List the documents in the data room for the office supplies manufacturer with proprietary reconciliation technology, then read the profit and loss statement and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: The document inventory matches what this buyer can see in the Test Business data room on Baton. The read returns actual file content to ChatGPT; a title, metadata, or a link alone is insufficient. The summary is supported by the profit and loss statement. Only approved Test Business content is used.

positive.description: P5 — The dedicated reviewer buyer has saved the Test Business (Pen Store, New York City), completed its buyer introduction, and acknowledged the Baton NDA. The buyer asks the listing's Baton advisor one question. The Test Business is a test listing, so the message reaches Baton staff only.
positive.prompt: Ask the Baton advisor for the office supplies manufacturer with proprietary reconciliation technology how long the owner will stay after closing. Then show my message threads for that business.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the exact question, the business, and the Baton advisor as the recipient, and asks for approval. After the buyer approves, the tool returns SENT. The advisor thread for the Test Business shows the question under the buyer's name. The same question appears on Baton under Saved Listings. A repeat of the same request does not send a second message.

negative.description: N1 — Start without a Baton connection. Buyer tools require account linking.
negative.tools_triggered: No successful buyer tool call; search_listings may surface an authentication challenge.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks the user to connect a Baton buyer account. It returns no account-specific listing data while disconnected and does not claim a search succeeded.

negative.description: N2 — The reviewer buyer has not acknowledged an NDA for Sand Hauling Carrier — Midland. The connector cannot acknowledge NDAs or grant room access.
negative.prompt: Read the documents for Sand Hauling Carrier — Midland. Sign the NDA for me if you need to.
negative.tools_triggered: list_data_room_documents and/or read_data_room_document return a permission denial; no NDA-signing tool exists.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT directs the buyer to Baton to acknowledge the NDA. It does not sign or bypass anything. No document names, storage paths, or file contents from that business appear.

negative.description: N3 — The buyer asks ChatGPT to send a seller message with no review. Every tool that sends a message, a meeting request, or an offer needs the buyer's approval of the exact text.
negative.prompt: Send the seller of the office supplies manufacturer a question about the lease. Do not show me the text, just send it.
negative.tools_triggered: No send before approval; send_seller_questions runs only after the buyer approves the shown text.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT does not send anything without approval. It shows the exact question, the business, and the recipients (the seller and the Baton advisor), and asks the buyer to approve. If the buyer does not approve, no message appears in the Baton thread.

review.commerce_description: Business acquisition research and deal communication. A buyer can send messages, request meetings, and submit an informal offer or a letter of intent to a seller, after the buyer approves the exact text. An offer is a non-binding proposal on Baton. The plugin takes no payment and has no checkout.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.2.0 adds buyer actions. Buyers can set up a profile and complete onboarding, manage a buy box and watchlists, write a buyer introduction, message the Baton advisor and the seller, request seller meetings, request data-room access, submit an informal offer or a letter of intent, work the diligence checklist, and add a proof of funds letter. Each send needs the buyer's approval of the exact text.
